title: Build AGP claim-control enforcement with MARKETING_CLAIMS.md and docs linting.
description:
# AGP Epic 11 — Build AGP claim-control enforcement with MARKETING_CLAIMS.md and docs linting.

## Why this exists
Stop security wording from outrunning primitives. CI gate fails on disallowed claims. v0 allowed: 'signed audit log of every tool call' ONLY. v0 banned: tamper-evident, tamper-proof, nonrepudiable, forensic, audit-grade, compliance-grade.

- scripts/claim-scan.sh (CREATE — banned-claims registry scanner)

- .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md (UPDATE — claim impact question)
- 000-docs/0NN-OD-PROC-emergency-claim-override.md (CREATE — Jeremy approval + Bead annotation rule)

## Acceptance criteria
- CI fails on disallowed claims in README, release notes, website copy, issue templates.
- No public-facing AGP doc inherits CCSC's casual 'tamper-evident' wording (per Epic 00 contradiction C6).
- Every marketing/security claim maps to a shipped primitive.
- Emergency override requires Jeremy approval + Bead annotation.

## Validation

# AGP Epic 05 — Build the internal Gateway protocol for sandbox-to-control-plane tool-call mediation.

Make sandbox-to-control-plane communication real and safe. Unix-socket transport ONLY at v0 — HTTP Gateway is FORBIDDEN until sender-constrained auth exists.

- Reference: AGP Threat Model (Epic 07 or later)

## Acceptance criteria
- Gateway is Unix-socket only at v0.
- No HTTP Gateway exposed.
- No public RFC (per AT-DECR Q5 + CSO 4-phase sequencing lock).
- Confused-deputy risk documented + test-covered.
- Replay + duplicate-message protections present.
- Fail-closed on malformed messages, missing verdicts, sandbox restart, control-plane crash.

## Validation

```
grep -RE 'http.*gateway|gateway.*http' src/  # expect zero results in v0
```

## Notes
HTTP Gateway prohibition is a security invariant, not a feature gap. Document WHY.

# AGP Epic 02 — Extract the CCSC governance kernel into an AGP-compatible substrate boundary.

## Why this exists
CCSC (claude-code-slack-channel) is currently a repo-root app package, not a clean reusable kernel. package.json exposes ./server.ts as the binary; license is MIT; modules live at repo root. AGP needs a deliberate extraction boundary, not copy-paste chaos. Strategy options: vendor / git submodule / path dependency / shared kernel package — TBD by ADR.

## Internal docs touched
- 000-docs/0NN-AT-ADR-ccsc-substrate-extraction-strategy.md (CREATE)
- 000-docs/0NN-AT-ARCH-substrate-boundary.md (CREATE)

- Reference: ~/000-projects/claude-code-slack-channel/000-docs/audit-journal-architecture.md
- Reference: ~/000-projects/claude-code-slack-channel/000-docs/policy-evaluation-flow.md

## Acceptance criteria
- No direct-import assumptions remain undocumented.
- AGP has a reproducible way to consume CCSC code (vendor / submodule / path dep / shared package — choice recorded in ADR).
- CCSC MIT ↔ AGP Apache 2.0 license boundary explicit in attribution.
- CCSC-to-AGP substrate compatibility tests exist and pass.
- Extraction ADR linked in all related child Beads + GH issues.
